test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error’.

It’s your carelessness that makes me went crazy all the time.
solution:
The error in the sentence is "**that makes me went.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**went**" is in the past tense, but it is used incorrectly here.
 
• In this context, the verb should be in the base form, which is "**go**," because you are expressing an ongoing or habitual action, not a past action.
 
• The correct phrase should be "that makes me go" instead of "that makes me went."
 
• **The corrected sentence**: "*It's your carelessness that makes me go crazy all the time.*"
 
• "**That makes me go**" is grammatically correct because it uses the base form "go" to express an ongoing or habitual action.
 
• "**Crazy**" is an adjective describing the speaker's state of mind.
 
• "**All the time**" indicates the frequency of the speaker feeling crazy due to the carelessness of the other person.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
